scope: Published0.5.0 to frozen0.6.0-rc.3 local owner-user upgrade in one offline disposable VM

app_development_policy.ddl: CREATE TABLE app_development_policy (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), body BLOB NOT NULL)

app_development_policy_history.ddl: CREATE TABLE app_development_policy_history (revision INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, actor TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL)

desk_adoptions.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_adoptions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES desk_operations(id),body BLOB NOT NULL)

desk_deployments.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_deployments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES desk_operations(id),body BLOB NOT NULL)

desk_frontends.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_frontends(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES desk_operations(id),body BLOB NOT NULL)

desk_operation_history.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_operation_history (id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES desk_operations(id), sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id,sequence))

desk_operations.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_operations (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, actor TEXT NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL)

desk_receivers.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_receivers(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES desk_operations(id),body BLOB NOT NULL)

desk_releases.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_releases(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES desk_operations(id),body BLOB NOT NULL)

desk_settings.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_settings (target TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body BLOB NOT NULL)

desk_settings_history.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_settings_history (target TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES desk_settings(target), revision INTEGER NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(target,revision))

desk_source_baselines.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_source_baselines (target TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body BLOB NOT NULL)

desk_source_ownership.ddl: CREATE TABLE desk_source_ownership(target TEXT PRIMARY KEY,body BLOB NOT NULL)

grubbery_app_clock.ddl: CREATE TABLE grubbery_app_clock (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=0))

grubbery_app_events.ddl: CREATE TABLE grubbery_app_events (id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES grubbery_app_operations(id), sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>0 AND sequence<=1024), digest TEXT NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id,sequence))

grubbery_app_leases.ddl: CREATE TABLE grubbery_app_leases (namespace TEXT PRIMARY KEY, id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES grubbery_app_operations(id))

grubbery_app_operations.ddl: CREATE TABLE grubbery_app_operations (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(ordinal>0), namespace TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, plan_digest TEXT NOT NULL, header_digest TEXT NOT NULL, framework_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES desk_operations(id), body BLOB NOT NULL, stamp TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=0 AND revision<=1024))

grubbery_app_runtime_heads.ddl: CREATE TABLE grubbery_app_runtime_heads (original_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES grubbery_app_operations(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=0 AND ordinal<=64), digest TEXT NOT NULL)

grubbery_app_runtime_recoveries.ddl: CREATE TABLE grubbery_app_runtime_recoveries (request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, original_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES grubbery_app_operations(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=1 AND ordinal<=64), previous_digest TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, body BLOB NOT NULL, UNIQUE(original_id,ordinal))

desktop_transition.loader: actual native sealed archive importer; activation acknowledgements driven by guest harness

status.message: Local services match this desktop bundle.

state.message: Service update completed. Your fleet is ready.

app_boundary: actual frozen CLI, restricted SSH, installed runner, Docker exec and native Clay; test operator explicitly opens only this fresh fake/desk gates; no Treaty/frontend claim from this scenario
limits: Native sealed-archive loading and actual offscreen QML service-update controls are tested; desktop activation acknowledgements are driven by the guest harness, not a production Omarchy shell.
Only the published0.5.0 local owner-user starting state is covered; older stable versions must follow their documented upgrade path first.
Remote service updates, active recording workers, live protected ships and power-loss durability are not tested by this scenario.
No product bytes were rebuilt, published, installed on the host, or merged to master. Immutable review delivery and shell activation remain separate gates.
